known_upstream_assumptions: The full campaign script mutates a Makefile and assumes specific ORFS revisions and design files.
The full campaign launcher invokes named remote hosts over SSH.
The analyst workbench uses the Anthropic SDK and an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
The platform adapter does not copy or modify upstream source; it materializes the upstream data contract in an isolated Runtime workspace.
Denied upstream entrypoints: maindriver.sh/run_or_job.py/run_agent.sh because they use SSH, eval remote output, mutate Makefiles, write .env, or create environments.
